unresolvedConflicts.subject: Puget Energy vs Puget Sound Energy
unresolvedConflicts.issue: The repository contains both the holding-company platform and its regulated operating subsidiary even though they represent one BCI manager-level investment.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Retain Puget Energy as the primary manager-level holding and classify Puget Sound Energy as MATCHED_ELSEWHERE beneath it unless the repository intentionally maintains separate subsidiary records.

unresolvedConflicts.subject: Corix vs Nexus Water Group
unresolvedConflicts.issue: The Corix restructuring and water-business combination created Nexus Water Group, but the completed evidence does not fully define the post-transaction boundary between retained Corix district-energy assets and the water and wastewater assets transferred to Nexus.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Retain Corix District Energy and Nexus Water Group as separate holdings while confirming their current asset perimeters and ownership through post-restructuring primary disclosures; do not merge them without that verification.

notes: All 16 supplied repository records were reconciled: 15 to included holdings and Puget Sound Energy as MATCHED_ELSEWHERE beneath Puget Energy.
Cleco Corporate Holdings remains included as SIGNED_PENDING_EXIT because the announced sale had not closed by 2026-07-28.
Connaught Oil and Gas and Corex Resources remain NEEDS_REVIEW because current BCI ownership and infrastructure-strategy attribution lack definitive primary confirmation.
